text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As Symboli Rudolf helps the students<n>ease into the
new year, she receives<n>the news that Air Groove
has<n>collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The reason turns out to be from<n>overwork, and
Rudolf blames herself<n>for letting Air Groove's
schedule get<n>so out of hand.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove snaps back, saying that<n>Rudolf doesn't
understand at<n>all—words that seem to strike home.
